tasks.label: stop-dds-server
args: $conns = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($null -eq $conns) { Write-Output 'No listener on 8000' } else { $pids = $conns.OwningProcess | Sort-Object -Unique; foreach ($pid in $pids) { try { Stop-Process -Id $pid -Force -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Output ('Stopped PID ' + $pid) } catch { Write-Output ('Failed to stop PID ' + $pid + ': ' + $_.Exception.Message) } } }
